title: ilex kingiana
intro: Ilex kingiana, commonly known as the Himalayan holly or King's holly, is a species of flowering plant in the family Aquifoliaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, headaches, and respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties. The health benefits of Ilex kingiana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including iridoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory activities. The therapeutic actions of Ilex kingiana include reducing fever, alleviating pain, and promoting the clearance of mucus from the respiratory tract, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
